title: AWS re:Invent Livestream Go beyond watching with guided labs and live Q&A
content: Live from re:Invent Experience re:Invent live and free. Ask subject matter experts your questions, react as launches land, and build in hands-on labs. Register free Build and ask questions live Follow AWS launches as they are announced, then learn how to put them to work. Keynotes are open to everyone, and talks and labs are free when you register. Catch every launch as it happens Hear AWS leaders share the latest launches live, and customers show what they have put into production. The Keynote Commentator Desk frames each launch, so you know what matters and where to go next. Hear where frontier AI is headed Researchers and open-source builders debate frontier AI. AWS, Amazon, and customer leaders share how they get value from AI, and security leaders cover protecting data at scale. Each talk includes live Q&A, so you can ask questions in real time. Leave with skills you can use In hands-on labs, virtual trainers guide you step by step in real time, so you can put what you learn to work. Inside the live experience Live keynote commentary See the full stage Follow along in your language Live keynote commentary The Keynote Commentator Desk takes you behind the scenes. Hosts preview speakers about 30 minutes before each keynote, then break down each launch and point you to the sessions that goes deeper. See the full stage Multi-camera coverage shows you the live demos and on-screen graphics alongside each speaker, so you can experience everything the audience in the room does. Follow along in your language Keynotes and talks include captions in English, French, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese. ASL interpretation and transcripts are also available. What’s streaming each day Choose what to be part of, and when Road to re:Invent kicks things off Sunday, November 29. From Monday, November 30, through Thursday, December 3, Live from re:Invent streams 50+ sessions including keynotes, talks, and labs. Register for free and sign in to see sessions and build your schedule. All times are PDT and the schedule is subject to change. Sunday, November 29 1 Monday, November 30 4 Tuesday, December 1 4 Wednesday, December 2 7 Thursday, December 3 4 Sunday, November 29 Open all Road to re:Invent 12:00 PM - 6:00 PM The official re:Invent Hackathon returns as a live game-show-style tournament. Six teams go head to head inside transparent cubes on the show floor, racing for a $100,000 grand prize. Jeff Barr and Swami Sivasubramanian open the show and crown the winners, with stage moments from Matt Garman, Julia White, and special guests throughout. Monday, November 30 Open all Session content 8:00 AM – 5:30 PM Advanced technical talks, sessions, and hands-on labs stream throughout the day. Register free to get session times and choose what to join. Keynote Commentator Desk 7:00 PM – 7:30 PM Hosts take you behind the scenes before the Developer Keynote, with a first look at who is taking the stage. Developer Keynote 7:30 PM – 8:45 PM Go from idea to live app in minutes, build agents that work, and trust the code AI writes. Speakers Clare Liguori, Sr. Principal Software Engineer, AWS Eric Johnson, Principal Developer Advocate, AWS Marc Brooker, VP and Distinguished Engineer, AWS Neha Rungta, Director, Applied Science, AWS Keynote Commentator Desk Recap 8:45 PM – 9:00 PM Hosts break down each launch from the Developer Keynote and point you to the sessions that go deeper. Tuesday, December 1 Open all Keynote Commentator Desk 8:00 AM – 8:30 AM Hosts preview the CEO keynote and the customer leaders from Allianz and DoorDash joining the stage. CEO Keynote 8:30 AM – 10:30 AM AWS CEO Matt Garman shares new launches and the innovations powering the agentic era, from AI infrastructure to agents. Speakers Matt Garman, CEO, AWS Barbara Karuth-Zelle, COO and Member of the Board, Allianz SE Tony Xu, Co-Founder and CEO, DoorDash Keynote Commentator Desk Recap 10:30 AM – 10:45 AM Hosts unpack announcements from the CEO keynote and what it could mean for what you build next. Session content 11:30 AM – 5:30 PM After the keynote, go deeper in technical talks and sessions where you can ask questions live in chat. Register free for the full lineup. Wednesday, December 2 Open all Keynote Commentator Desk 8:00 AM – 8:30 AM Get context for the Data & AI Keynote and the challenge at its center: moving agents into production. Session content 8:00 AM – 5:30 PM Build alongside trainers in hands-on labs, or join technical talks and sessions with live Q&A. Register free to plan your day. Data & AI Keynote 8:30 AM – 10:00 AM Learn what it takes to move agents from demo to production: reliable access to data, proven value, and clear limits.
